integrity: Complete theorem and hypotheses are supplied with a proof, an exact rational strict witness, and a standalone standard-library Python checker; no experimental data or independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Idealized exogenous routing; independent Poisson adverse encounters with intensity proportional to allocated attempted traffic. No empirical calibration, behavior, equilibrium, or infrastructure costs. For n>=3 the full global-transition frontier is not determined; historical priority outside inspected sources remains provisional.
title: A subcritical symmetry-breaking law for encounter-limited wildlife crossings
